notes: Cumulative Safety Tracker build. Preserves v2.11.67 Management navigation, v2.11.66 People/Department/Operational Overseer controls and v2.11.65 controlled document-set reviews. Simplifies Admin Management setup into three clear tiles: Departments, Positions and Users. Departments has dedicated create/edit/archive management with HOD/Operational Overseer visibility. Positions has dedicated create/edit/archive management and keeps Department as a suggestion/reporting link rather than silently changing a user's explicit Main Department. Users becomes the single person setup flow: Account & Site, Department, Position, Responsibilities & Permissions, Groups, then Review & Save. New users default to the current Safety site. Operational Overseer remains selectable by exact Departments and does not replace the official HOD. Direct Group membership is editable from User setup while Department/Position inherited Groups are shown automatically. Database support for direct user Group assignment is already applied.
